newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank says Vandiver to head risk unit.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank says Vandiver to head risk unit.

text.p: NationsBank Corp said F. William Vandiver Jr. will become chairman of corporate risk policy, succeeding Fredric Figge, who will retire at the end of the year.
Vandiver, who has been employed by NationsBank since 1967, was formerly president of Global Finance.

Vandiver's risk policy responsibilities include balance sheet management, credit policy, asset quality review, audit, compliance and regulatory relations. Vandiver will report to chief executive Hugh McColl.
NationsBank said Edward Brown III, formerly president of corporate finance, has been named president of global finance, replacing Vandiver.

Brown will report to James Hance Jr., vice chairman and chief financial officer, who in addition to his current responsibilities will assume overall responsibility for corporate finance, capital markets, real estate and global treasury and trade activities.

NationsBank said Kenneth Lewis, president of NationsBank Corp, would assume overall responsibility for the NationsCredit Corp unit. The company's consumer finance subsidiary is led by its chairman and president, Bob Sessoms, who will report to Lewis.

In related moves, Gregory Curl, vice chairman of corporate development, will assume additional responsibility for NationsCredit Commercial and the specialized lending function, reporting to Lewis. Stephen Irish, president of NationsCredit Commercial, and Bart Smith, who leads specialized lending, will report to Curl.
